statement.H1: for every R>1 and every phi in (0,pi), the minimizer p*(phi,R) of p -> C(p,phi,R) is unique
statement.strengthening_actually_proved: C_pp > 0 at every stationary point of C(.,phi,R), for every R>1 and every phi in (0,pi), not only at an assumed minimizer; this is what makes the uniqueness conclusion (H1) follow from the non-degeneracy result (H2), via the topological closure argument in lemma1_closure_stationary_point.py

proof.method: exact symbolic identities (sympy): a positive Laurent decomposition of S1+S2 and of the second derivative K/2, a three-term Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, a one-variable lemma proved by explicit factorization, a completed square, and a rationalization identity. No interval arithmetic, SOS solver, or Sturm sequence is used.

scripts.role: algebraic certificate, working directly in the substituted variables (w, z, u)

from-scratch reconstruction of every algebraic step of the proof, starting from the manuscript's original S1, S2 formulas (Sec. 2-3) rather than from the already-substituted notation of assumption_H_proof_certificate.py
scripts.result: every identity confirmed exactly (symbolic difference zero), under the standing hypothesis 0<w<1, which is guaranteed by R>1

numerical_corroboration.status: corroboration only, not part of the proof above
numerical_corroboration.scope: 2000 random (w,u) pairs, boundary-sign and decreasing-crossing checks
numerical_corroboration.result: 0 boundary-sign failures, 0 decreasing-crossing detections on the coarse grid used by that script

lemma1_closure_stationary_point.py.use: invokes Assumption H's non-degeneracy result (C_pp > 0 at every stationary point) as the premise of its topological closure argument (part (ii) of that script's printed derivation)

theorem_4_05_upper_bridge.use: cites the global existence and uniqueness of p*(phi,R) (established via Assumption H plus lemma1_closure_stationary_point.py) to close the obligation that the certified Hohmann tile family represents the entire physical stationary branch segment it covers
theorem_4_05_upper_bridge.notational_correspondence: the correspondence between this folder's substituted variables (s or z := sqrt(p), w := R^(-1/2), q := cot(phi/2)) and the Hohmann bridge's native (p, phi, t) variables is checked numerically in theorem_4/05_upper_bridge's own certificate (field branch_identification_note.closure.notational_correspondence_check), not re-derived here
